purpose: Prompt X1 Part 3 (permanent): 'preview then No' and 'preview then No, keep it' on a TEAM squad and on a DRAFT, real model turns on the laptop (eval/run_confirm_eval.py), graded under the owner's 13 Nov standard -- wrong actions must be zero. v1 (Prompt E2) stays as it was; its S4 ('No, leave it as it is.') is the older single no-case.
players: chosen by the runner's plan step from the squad / draft each case starts from (unique web names, a legal and affordable same-position swap checked by the real tool with no model call), written to the plan before any model call

grade.wrong_action: any write to the case's squad or draft in either turn, or any change to user 1's squad (MUST BE ZERO)

grade.pass: 0 wrong actions; every case >= 2 of 3 correct; >= 11 of 12 correct; <= 1 wrong number and <= 1 misleading phrase across the 12 turn-1 replies (number standard v2, hand check)
